notes: Man in beanie swings the door leaf open and props it; older man in beige jacket then stands behind the glass without clearly leaving; beanie man vanishes from centre in last row, direction unclear.

Camo-jacket man and blue-beanie woman appear near the camera heading into the room, entry point not actually seen; a man in a cap shows for one tile by the leaf and is not counted; older man stands behind the glass all minute.
Bearded man in cap comes in from behind the glass leaf; older man in beige jacket who had been standing behind the glass for minutes walks back into the room (counted as a re-entry).

A grey-haired person in a light jacket walks behind the glass leaf in the last row and fades from view; men standing near the camera partly hide the edge, and a man in a grey vest appears near the camera with no visible entry.
Older man in beige jacket walks out behind the glass leaf; men appearing near the camera in the last row look like people already in the room.
Older man in beige jacket comes back in from behind the glass about 90 seconds after leaving; man in cap walks toward the camera and drops out of frame at the bottom, not counted as leaving.

Curly-haired woman in cream quilted jacket walks out behind the glass; man in cap stands at the leaf edge talking to someone outside for about 30 s then disappears, taken as leaving; faint figures linger behind the glass most of the minute.

Two men (cap, beanie) show up together striding into the room in one tile of the last row, right after a pale figure passes behind the glass; taken as coming in from the door, the cap man likely returning; man in beige jacket stands at the leaf edge without crossing.
Beanie man and cap man each walk toward the camera and drop out of frame; both are back in the room next minute so not counted as leaving.
Beanie man passes behind the glass and out of view; cap man steps behind the glass and stays standing there, visible, to the end of the strip (not counted as departed).

Cap man who was standing behind the glass steps back into the room to talk with a man in a grey vest, then returns behind the glass and stays visible there; he is hovering in the doorway rather than truly coming and going.

Beanie man walks toward the door and is gone by the next tile (taken as leaving, though his earlier return was never seen); cap man stands behind the glass nearly all minute then steps back into the room at the end.
Cap man moves around the room and ends standing by the leaf edge.
Cap man stands by the leaf edge on his phone all minute.

Cap man steps behind the glass for about 4 s and is back in the room two tiles later (or a second person briefly looked in); treated as no net movement. Beanie man reappears near the camera at the end with no visible entry.
Man in grey vest comes in from behind the glass (he was in the room a minute earlier); two more faint figures pass behind the glass in the middle row without clearly entering or leaving.
Cap man steps behind the glass for a few seconds and comes straight back; a blue beanie close to the camera blocks the edge for parts of the last two rows.

A dark-haired man holding a box and then the curly-haired woman in the cream jacket (who left about 12 min earlier) each appear at the right edge close to the camera and are greeted; neither was seen passing the glass, so entry through the door is inferred.
A blue beanie right in front of the camera covers much of the frame for about a third of the minute; the glass leaf stays mostly visible and nobody is seen through it.
Cap man steps behind the glass, stands there visible for about 50 s (apparently talking with a second, white-haired figure who never comes in), then walks back into the room; counted as one re-entry.
Man in grey vest walks out behind the glass leaf near the end of the top row.

Man in grey vest is seen through the glass and then inside at the start of the last row, about 2.5 min after leaving; cap man dips behind the glass for a tile or two and then stands at the leaf edge talking, not counted.
Blue beanie briefly in front of the camera for two tiles; door side otherwise empty.
Blue beanie covers the left of the frame for several tiles but the door side stays visible and empty.

Man in grey vest and cap man go back and forth around the leaf edge, the vest man standing behind the glass for most of the minute before coming back in at the end; nobody clearly leaves for good, and a blue beanie blocks several tiles.

Cap man and then the man in the beige jacket step behind the glass and stay standing there, visible, to the end of the strip (not counted as departed); blue beanie in front of the camera hides parts of several tiles.

Cap man and the man in the beige jacket each come back from behind the glass to the room side of the leaf; a figure in a cap keeps standing behind the glass all minute. Same few people loitering in the doorway, no new visitors seen.
The figure in a cap who had been standing behind the glass for about two minutes finally walks off out of view mid-strip; blue beanie blocks five tiles of the top row.

Two young men (dark cap; curly hair in cream sweater) appear together at the right edge, then a woman in a patterned headscarf; further figures are visible behind the glass in the last row while the beanie man goes to the door and puts a hand on the leaf, outcome continues next strip.

Beanie man stands at the door holding the leaf (no visible change of angle) while faint figures stand outside behind the glass and the headscarf woman moves past him out of sight, possibly leaving; later people close to the camera and a blue beanie hide the edge in about a third of the tiles.

Man in beige jacket steps behind the glass in the last row and stays standing there in view to the end; cap man crosses in front of the leaf in the second-to-last tile and is gone in the last, direction unclear.

Man in beige jacket, who had been standing behind the glass, comes back to the room side near the end of the top row; a pale figure keeps moving about behind the glass in the middle row; man in grey vest close to the camera hides part of the edge for half the strip.

The two young men (cream sweater, dark cap) walk out of frame to the right past the front of the leaf at the end, the same way they first appeared, taken as leaving; figures stand behind the glass on and off all minute and the man in the beige jacket steps behind it again; heads near the camera block some tiles.

Two new women (grey curly hair with dark coat and scarf; long locs with black jacket and backpack) appear at the right edge close to the camera in the last row, neither seen through the glass; man in grey vest steps behind the glass for one tile and comes straight back, not counted.
Man in beige jacket walks behind the glass, stands there in view for about 40 s, then comes back into the room; counted as one re-entry and no departure.

A woman with a bun in a black coat appears at the right near the camera and walks into the room (entry not seen); a figure in a cream jacket goes behind the glass late in the middle row and lingers at the very edge through the last row; cap near the camera blocks four tiles.
